body:
[A10] **Lane for #151: parameter guards that stop every front end.** Executor [A593], reviewers [R604] (internal) and [R605] (external). Branch `pp151-guards` from main `2cbed0a9`.

**Scope.**
- Inventory every elaboration-time parameter guard in `hdl/`, not only the ones listed in the body: generate-scope and initial-scope `$error`/`$warning`/`$info`/`$fatal` on parameters, and any equivalent. Give file:line for each.
- Make every guard stop elaboration in each front end the project uses:
  - Verilator lint, as `scripts/lint_hdl.sh` and the parent run it;
  - sv2v plus Yosys, at the versions CI pins;
  - xvlog/Vivado.
- Whether that takes `$fatal` everywhere or a measured per-front-end form is your design decision. Record it in the coding rules with the measurement behind it.
- No guard changes its condition. No passing elaboration changes: the shipping shapes' netlists and ROM digests are identical at base and head.

**Proof.**
- Per guard, through each of the three front ends:
  - a violating parameter set is refused, quoting the front end's own words;
  - the nearest passing set elaborates.
- A bench grades each guard's severity, not only its message. A `$error` and a `$warning` mutant of every guard are killed by name.
- The processor suites, `scripts/lint_hdl.sh`, `make check`, `scripts/gen_matrix.py --check` and `syn/yosys/run.sh` pass at base and head, and every record is identical.
- Scratch parent at dev `e8454e27` with the gitlink at your head: the parent's Yosys elaboration and Verilator lint pass for its shapes, and no shipping shape trips a guard. The manager runs the donor and consumer banks.

The parent adoption joins the next batched processor adoption with #708's inputs. Post TAKEN, then REVIEW READY (or STOP) with the head.
